channel.title: Electronic on Hsing-An Lee
channel.description: Hsing-An Lee is a recorder player and composer.

item.title: hazy
item.description:
This work was completed with classmates from a university elective course, using alternative electronic music as its stylistic direction.
The piece takes a synth bass as its central motive, exploring the flow and suspension of the music.
It describes the boundary between &ldquo;hazy&rdquo; and &ldquo;clear&rdquo; through sound.
Credit: Lyrics: Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu, Yu-An Liu Composer: Hsing-An Lee, Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu Arrangement: Hsing-An Lee Vocals: Hsing-An Lee, Pei-Yu Lin, He-Hsin Wu

item.title: Polygatari - 祭り(Matsuri)
item.description:
A contemporary recorder work blending jazz, electronic music, and Japanese folk-inspired elements. This is one of my most representative works.
This work received Second Prize and the Best Composition Award at Open Recorder Days Amsterdam 2023.
item.content:encoded:
A contemporary recorder work blending jazz, electronic music, and Japanese folk-inspired elements. This is one of my most representative works.

This work received Second Prize and the Best Composition Award at Open Recorder Days Amsterdam 2023.

In this piece, I used the DAW Reason as my creative tool. Inspired by odd-meter music, I experimented with an uneven seven-beat rhythmic structure.
In live performance, the piece combines live looping with a pre-programmed track. The recorder sound is also routed into the computer, where effects open up a wider range of timbral possibilities.

Polygatari - 祭り(Matsuri) Monogatari (物語) means “story” in Japanese. Just as monophony evolves into polyphony, I wanted my monogatari to evolve as well.
Matsuri (祭り) means festival.

As the third piece in the Polygatari series, this is probably a festival taking place under a full moon, somewhere below the castle. The people here move with a staggering yet light step; he wears a white amoeba-patterned shirt, he wears a haori, he is restrained, yet free.
And he is very handsome.

 Open Recorder Days Amsterdam 2023 Competition
 Recorder & Electronic: Hsing-An Lee
 Composer: Hsing-An Lee
